mechanism: Cobicistat is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase piperacillin exposure and potentially affect tazobactam metabolism, while piperacillin-tazobactam may induce renal clearance pathways affecting cobicistat levels.
action: Monitor for increased piperacillin-tazobactam adverse effects (neurotoxicity, seizures); consider renal function monitoring and dose adjustment if necessary; assess cobicistat efficacy as beta-lactams may reduce levels.
